last_result.headline: Q21 CLOSED, gate fails all three conditions. Structural discovery: the stored 'PF mean path' is NOT a mean -- softmax_T5 reproduces it exactly, so it is the deployed likelihood-weighted ensemble at scale=5.0. The temperature sweep therefore became a nested test of the deployed scale=5.0, never previously validated, and it sits at a near-optimal interior point: only softmax_T10 beats it (+0.0526 = 1.4% of headroom), sharpening is monotonically harmful down to hard selection (-0.878), flattening and robust combiners are worse. Nested across 27 combiners: -0.0326, helps 43.2% of wells, 3-well 5th -0.7353. Closes the entire soft-combination family, extending Q11's closure of hard selection. No submission regardless: the PF-path line is 2.07 worse than deployed. Q36 still in flight (~2 h left).
